# Templates de fixtures do sanitizador (ADR-14). Nenhuma linha contém segredo literal.
# Formato: rótulo|tipo|template. Tipos: pos (deve redigir), neg (não pode mudar), cut (segredo
# no ponto em que o teto de corpo o cortaria; prova que a redação roda antes do corte).
# Placeholders, expandidos pelo teste: <<UP#n>> <<HEX#n>> <<MIX#n>> (preenchimento de n chars),
# <<PEM#X>> (-----X-----), <<DOT#x>> (.x), <<EQ>> (=), <<COLON>> (:), <<HOME>>, <<WIN_HOME>>,
# e a sequência literal backslash-n para quebra de linha.
private_key|pos|<<PEM#BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY>>\n<<MIX#64>>\n<<PEM#END RSA PRIVATE KEY>>
private_key|neg|<<PEM#BEGIN PUBLIC KEY>>\nMIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEF\n<<PEM#END PUBLIC KEY>>
private_key|cut|<<PEM#BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY>>\n<<MIX#64>>\n<<PEM#END RSA PRIVATE KEY>>
url_credentials|pos|https://deploy<<COLON>><<MIX#16>>@git.example.com/repo.git
url_credentials|neg|https://git.example.com/repo.git
url_credentials|cut|https://deploy<<COLON>><<MIX#16>>@git.example.com/repo.git
auth_header|pos|Authorization<<COLON>> <<MIX#24>>
auth_header|pos|X-Api-Key<<COLON>> <<MIX#24>>
auth_header|neg|Idempotency-Key<<COLON>> 6f1c2e9a-retry-safe
auth_header|cut|Authorization<<COLON>> <<MIX#24>>
bearer_token|pos|Bearer <<MIX#24>>
bearer_token|neg|bearer curto
bearer_token|cut|Bearer <<MIX#24>>
api_key|pos|sk-<<MIX#24>>
api_key|neg|sk-curto
api_key|cut|sk-<<MIX#24>>
stripe_key|pos|sk_live_<<MIX#16>>
stripe_key|neg|sk_test_<<MIX#16>>
stripe_key|cut|sk_live_<<MIX#16>>
github_token|pos|ghp_<<MIX#24>>
github_token|pos|github_pat_<<MIX#24>>
github_token|neg|ghp_curto
github_token|cut|github_pat_<<MIX#24>>
aws_key|pos|AKIA<<UP#16>>
aws_key|neg|ASIAPACIFICREGION
aws_key|cut|AKIA<<UP#16>>
google_api_key|pos|AIza<<MIX#30>>

google_api_key|neg|AIzaCurto
google_api_key|cut|AIza<<MIX#30>>
google_oauth|pos|1//<<MIX#20>>
google_oauth|neg|1//curto
google_oauth|cut|1//<<MIX#20>>
meta_token|pos|EAA<<MIX#24>>
meta_token|neg|EAAcurto
meta_token|cut|EAA<<MIX#24>>
telegram_token|pos|123456789<<COLON>><<MIX#35>>
telegram_token|neg|12345<<COLON>>curto-token
telegram_token|cut|123456789<<COLON>><<MIX#35>>
ghl_token|pos|pit-<<HEX#8>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#12>>
ghl_token|neg|pit-sem-uuid
ghl_token|cut|pit-<<HEX#8>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#4>>-<<HEX#12>>
slack_token|pos|xoxb-<<MIX#24>>
slack_token|pos|xapp-<<MIX#24>>
slack_token|neg|xoxb-curto
slack_token|cut|xoxb-<<MIX#24>>
jwt|pos|eyJ<<MIX#20>>.<<MIX#20>>.<<MIX#20>>
jwt|neg|internal.storage.writer
jwt|cut|eyJ<<MIX#20>>.<<MIX#20>>.<<MIX#20>>
base64_json_token|pos|eyJ<<MIX#40>>
base64_json_token|neg|eyJcurto
base64_json_token|cut|eyJ<<MIX#40>>
env_secret|pos|GITHUB_TOKEN<<EQ>><<MIX#20>>
env_secret|pos|AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY<<COLON>> <<MIX#20>>
env_secret|neg|MAX_TOKENS<<EQ>>100
env_secret|cut|GITHUB_TOKEN<<EQ>><<MIX#20>>
credential_path|pos|<<HOME>>/<<DOT#ssh>>/id_ed25519
credential_path|pos|<<WIN_HOME>>\<<DOT#aws>>\credentials
credential_path|neg|/home/dev/docs/readme.md
credential_path|neg|~/projects/sshd-notes
credential_path|cut|<<HOME>>/<<DOT#ssh>>/id_ed25519
